candidates.title: Curiosity Rover’s Most Challenging Climb Yet (Mars Report - August 2023)
candidates.description: NASA’s Curiosity rover recently made its most challenging climb on Mars. Curiosity faced a steep, slippery slope on its journey up Mount Sharp, so rover drivers had to come up with a creative detour.
